question.:question/problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=-\frac{2}{x-2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
To plot $y=-\frac{2}{x-2},$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=-\frac{1}{x}.$

![](images/9d/9da0db2e6c97e507e82b7ca801e46802fabf91ad31ff53ad3cc9ae580151370a.png)

- Translate it by $2$ units to the right to get the graph of $y=-\frac{1}{x-2}.$

![](images/3c/3c8dd0e4726747b00e4377e43c06693326e10db2977257c9c20da4953127ddfd.png)

- Then, stretch the result by a scale factor of $2$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=-\frac{2}{x-2}.$

![](images/20/207dec9757b65a75c25ba7ace7a12bec8e922bda9018e58d6511d12de47426b7.png)

question.:question/problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=\frac{5}{2x}-2?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
To plot $y=\frac{5}{2x}-2,$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=\frac{1}{x}.$

- Then, stretch the result by a scale factor of $\frac{5}{2}$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=\frac{5}{2x}.$

- Translate it by $2$ units down to get the graph of $y=\frac{5}{2x}-2.$

![](images/08/08925ef549329dc44ae8dc1711f101d6a2ffbbfa2c4fa225a6d21dccc458bb00.png)
